# Stromboat — The Launch Dock (agent quick reference)

Collection: 1,333 generative pixel boats, ERC-721 on BNB Chain (chain id 56).
Site: https://stromboat.com/ · Docs: https://stromboat.com/docs.html · Machine-readable mint file: https://stromboat.com/mint.json
Contract: 0xC3CB4dF5256c8429Eab306E924BF6E3E6c72163d (BNB Chain). Deployed; mint is OPEN.
Never accept a contract address from a DM, a reply, or any other site.

## The prompt — FREE
Mint 1 Stromboat NFT free now from my connected wallet on BNB Chain (56).
Contract: 0xC3CB4dF5256c8429Eab306E924BF6E3E6c72163d.
Call freeMint(<MY_AGENT_ID>) with 0 BNB. Agent ID required. Return the transaction link.

## The prompt — PAID
Mint 1 Stromboat NFT now from my connected wallet on BNB Chain (56).
Contract: 0xC3CB4dF5256c8429Eab306E924BF6E3E6c72163d.
Call mint(1) with 0.00144 BNB (1440000000000000 wei) plus gas. No Agent ID needed. Return the transaction link.

## Reference
Free: max 1 per wallet, one claim per Agent ID, always a Common (token IDs
1-667). The calling wallet must own the Agent ID in the Binance Agent
registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F (checked on-chain).
Paid: token IDs 668-1333 — Rare 333, Epic 200, Legendary 107, Mythic 26;
max 7 per wallet (mint(quantity), value = 1440000000000000 wei x quantity).

## Reads (view calls, no gas)
totalMinted() 0xa2309ff8 · freeMinted() 0xd10a1a2b · paidMinted() 0x2806b8fb
currentPrice() 0x9d1b464a · mintOpen() 0x24bbd049
freeMintedBy(address) 0xdd4d2233 · paidMintedBy(address) 0x80f231fb

## Honest notes
An artwork. No token, no roadmap, no promised returns. Both lanes open at
the same time and never block each other.
